name: XRPName
description: XRPL domain names (.xrp / .xrpl / .xrpfi / .rlusd) and an x402 gateway for agent payments — buy/register a domain or pay a project, agent-native, non-custodial.

resources.name: Register an XRPName domain
resources.description: Buy and register a root XRPName domain (.xrp/.xrpl/.xrpfi/.rlusd) via x402: pay in XRP or RLUSD, mint, then sign NFTokenAcceptOffer. GET returns a representative quote; POST { domain } registers a specific domain at its exact price. The live 402 lists every payment option in accepts[]; the payer picks one.

accepts.note: RLUSD (USD-pegged). Amount is priced from the XRP price at the live XRP/USD rate and locked per-invoice; read the exact figure from the 402.
